definition: Oriented scalar-triple-product volume around the stereocenter using a fixed local atom-order convention; sign records local tetrahedral orientation.
Signed out-of-plane displacement of the selected exocyclic substituent relative to the oriented fused-ring plane.
Normalized stereocenter-to-substituent vector projected onto the oriented ring normal.
Directed torsion defined by the selected exocyclic substituent, stereocenter, and two ordered fused-ring neighbors.
Directed dihedral referenced to the N or S atom with the smallest 3D Euclidean distance to the stereocenter; through-space nearest-heteroatom rule.
Sine transform of the pre-existing baseline P/M dihedral; not recomputed from the new conformer.
Cosine transform of the pre-existing baseline P/M dihedral; removes angular discontinuity with sine encoding and is not individually sign-reversing.
